# planCacheSize and $planCacheStats — facts

> Source-anchored units about planCacheSize and $planCacheStats: 8 across 4 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-22 · 8 units · 4 sources · rights: quote -->

## Definitions

- [statement] `$planCacheStats` is a collection-scoped aggregation stage that must appear first and returns one document per cache entry; its output can include `isActive`, `works`, and `estimatedSizeBytes` for inspecting entries and their estimated per-entry sizes. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/plancachestats/ · keywords: planCacheSize and $planCacheStats · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-query-plan-cache-explained-performance-pitfalls-and-re-planning/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/planCacheStats.md
- [statement] The `estimatedSizeBytes` field is an estimate for one cache entry, not an exact total for the whole plan cache. MongoDB's serializer populates that output field from the entry's `estimatedEntrySizeBytes` value. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/planCacheStats.md · keywords: planCacheSize and $planCacheStats · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/query/explain.cpp

## How it works

- [statement] The plan cache is in memory and per collection, is discarded when `mongod` restarts, and uses LRU replacement to remove the least recently accessed entry. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans/ · keywords: planCacheSize and $planCacheStats · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-query-plan-cache-explained-performance-pitfalls-and-re-planning/, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/query-plans-and-query-replanning

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Starting in MongoDB 6.3, `planCacheSize` is a `mongod` string parameter with a 5% default; it accepts a percentage of system total physical memory or a fixed MB/GB amount and supports startup and runtime changes. MongoDB documents it as applying only to the slot-based query execution engine's plan cache. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters/ · keywords: planCacheSize and $planCacheStats · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-query-plan-cache-explained-performance-pitfalls-and-re-planning/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md
- [statement] Starting in MongoDB 5.0, when cumulative plan-cache size across collections exceeds 0.5 GB, MongoDB stores later entries without `createdFromQuery`, `cachedPlan`, `creationExecStats`, or `candidatePlanScores`; `$planCacheStats` also documents `estimatedSizeBytes` as an individual entry estimate. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans/ · keywords: planCacheSize and $planCacheStats · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/plancachestats/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Plan cache contents are local to each `mongod` and can differ between members. By default, `$planCacheStats` follows read preference and returns data from one member per replica set; on sharded clusters, `allHosts: true` broadcasts to all nodes for affected shards. The `allHosts` option was added in MongoDB 7.1. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/planCacheStats.md · keywords: planCacheSize and $planCacheStats · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-query-plan-cache-explained-performance-pitfalls-and-re-planning/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/plancachestats/, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/query-plans-and-query-replanning
- [statement] Per-entry inspection and aggregate hit/miss monitoring provide different views: DataDog's MongoDB integration release 6.10.0, dated 2024-09-05, added plan cache hit and miss rate metrics for MongoDB 7.0 and later. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/planCacheStats.md · keywords: planCacheSize and $planCacheStats · also: https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/blob/master/mongo/CHANGELOG.md
- [statement] Increasing `planCacheSize` can let the planner retain more query shapes and may improve query performance, but it also increases memory use. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters/ · keywords: planCacheSize and $planCacheStats · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-query-plan-cache-explained-performance-pitfalls-and-re-planning/
